identification: Lalique France frosted crystal dove ring dish (Colombe / Pigeon style pin tray), clear dish with frosted dove with raised wings on a central column, about 10 cm high. Base shows an etched 'Lalique France' script signature, only partly legible in photo 3. No chips seen, light surface scratches to the dish. The signature is consistent with modern (post-1945) Lalique France, but fakes exist.

viewing_check: Check the base signature under good light: genuine has a clear etched 'Lalique France' (modern, no R. Lalique) with crisp frosted wing feather detail; poor, shallow or misspelt script suggests a fake. Look for chips on wing tips, rim and base ring, and whether the dove is cleanly joined to the column. Photograph the base and any model number.
